12.12.2024 Order No.
02. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. This bail application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. arising out of C.T. Case No.1542 of 2023 in connection with Chandrasekharpur P.S Case No.639 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C. (COG-II), Bhubaneswar is taken up for consideration.
3. I have already heard from the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned ASC for the State.

4. The petitioners have been charge-sheeted on dated 12.07.2024 under Sections 419 & 420 read with Section 34 of the IPC, 1860 on the allegations alleged against them that, they (petitioners) had committed robbery of a gold chain from the mother of the informant and they (petitioners) have cheated mother of the informant projecting them (petitioners) falsely as police personnels.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted for liberal consideration of their bail contending that, the offences alleged against the petitioners are magisterial triable in nature and they (petitioners) are in jail custody since 17.05.2024 for about 5 months, to which, the learned ASC for the State objected contending that, the petitioners belong to out of the State and there is every possibility of their absconding after their release on bail, for which, they (petitioners) should not be allowed to go on bail.
6. When the petitioners are in jail custody for about more than 6 months in this magisterial triable ) Fazal Alli @ Fazal Ali @ vs State Of Odisha .....

sentences.text:

1 nature of the case and when the investigation of the case has already been completed during the staying of the petitioners inside the jail, then, at this juncture, by taking the above factors into account, instead of rejecting the bail application of the petitioners, it is felt proper to allow the petitioners to go on bail with stringent conditions looking to the future safety and security of the victim, informant, witnesses as well as the interest of the prosecution.
7.
Hence, the bail application filed by the petitioners is allowed.

8. They (petitioners) are allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(rupees fifty thousand) with two solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court in seisin over the case with conditions that :-
(i) They (petitioners) shall not involve with similar nature of crime in future.
(ii) They (petitioners) shall appear before the court personally on each date of adjournment of the case till its conclusion.

(iii) They (petitioners) shall not terrorize, coerce, influence or threat to any witnesses of the prosecution either directly or indirectly in any manner whatsoever at any stage of the trial of the case,
iv) They (petitioners) shall appear before the IIC, Chandrasekharpur P.S. on each Sunday once during the day time, hence, till the end of March, 2025 intimating the IIC, Chandrasekharpur that, they are not involved in any other case;
but, in case of their failure to comply any one of the aforesaid conditions, the learned trial court is authorized to cancel their respective bail orders outrightly without seeking any permission for the same from this Court.
9.
Accordingly, the bail application of the petitioners is disposed of finally.

10. Grant certified copy of this order to the petitioners on proper application.
( ANANDA CHANDRA BEHERA) Judge Rati Ranjan Designation: Senior Stenographer Location:
High Court of Orissa, Cuttack, India.
